full_judgment: 18. Order V, rule 19A enshrines that a declaration made and subscribed by serving officer shall be received as evidence of the facts as to the service or attempted service of summons. Service of summons had been verified by serving Officer i.e. process server and learned Judge having been satisfied with verification in respect of service of summons declared that service had been duly served and declaration had been entered by learned Judge in order No. 58 dated 8-8-1989: Law and procedure in respect of service of summons transpired to have been observed and followed in respect of due service of summons upon defendant Nos. 18(ka)-18(gaha). Section 114(e) of the Evidence Act enjoins that Court may presume that Judicial and official acts have been regularly performed. Service of summons is judicial/official act. A presumption as to due service of summons upon defendant Nos. 18(ka)-18(gaha) has been attached.
